column2: Paste before every Image Description: "A single game icon for a whimsical, expressive young-adult indie RPG card game with painterly card art. One centered symbol with a bold, instantly readable silhouette that still reads at 32x32 pixels. Clean thick dark outline, limited palette, subtle painterly shading with soft light from the upper left, consistent stroke weight and lighting across the whole icon set. Filling about 80% of the canvas, centered. Fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). No text, no letters, no numbers, no frame or badge unless described. Square, 1024x1024." Apply the Path accent if the row names a Path: Beefcake = gold and warm red; Necrocrat = gray and sickly green; Gourmand = cream and copper; Refusemancer = moss green and rust; Colorless = stone gray and parchment.

Save each icon as its ID (e.g. ICON-KW-FLYING.png) and move approved icons to Card Game Art / Approved_Icons. Icons are generated large (1024) and the game downsizes them. Generate a whole category in one ChatGPT conversation so the set stays consistent.
